content.title: An Orthodox Creed (1679)
content.author: General Baptists of Buckinghamshire and neighbouring counties · text in McGlothlin, Baptist Confessions of Faith (1911)
content.note: The General (non-Calvinist) Baptist confession (agreed 1678, printed 1679; McGlothlin dates it 1678), written to show agreement with the historic creeds against Christological error, and holding that Christ died for all. Cited beside the Second London Confession where Baptists differ, so both strands of Baptist history are heard. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator or edition named and an exact locator.
